cover.headline: Proof: correct. Readable: no.
cover.dek: A computer certified an AI-assisted proof of maths’ most famous open problem. No human has read it end to end. Plus 5 more things that moved in AI this week.
cover.swipe: Your week in AI, in 2 minutes →

scoreAka: aka. 6 stories, and how true each one is

summary.text: Riemann hypothesis: AI-assisted proof certified by Lean.
AI agents go abroad: Meta Muse to UK, Claude Duet to India.
Microsoft: state hackers now use an AI break‑in agent.
Claude rewrote Anthropic’s API. Tests lied.
Data centres cleared for orbit; Nvidia chips in Shanghai.
Chariot‑1, a Sarvam row, and 3,300 GPUs for Pune.

stats.l: the year Riemann posed the problem
lines of Lean code that check the proof (Science News)

slides.plain: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude. The Lean community certified the computer-checked proof on 21 Nov.
slides.aside: Math teachers: “show your work.” Claude: 17 million lines.
slides.sowhat: A machine can now confirm a proof no human has read end to end. Maths just got a new kind of “trust me”.
slides.src: Lean FRO + Mathlib, 21 Nov; Science News; Scientific American · AI-written explanation unreleased

slides.wit: AI agents got passports this week.
slides.plain: Meta launched its Muse shopping agent in the UK (24 Nov). Anthropic opened Claude Duet’s waitlist to India, Indonesia, Brazil and Japan (25 Nov).
slides.sowhat: Muse must ask before it buys anything. That “approve first” button is the feature Indian users will trust first.
slides.src: Meta newsroom, 24 Nov; Claude Duet product page; Drapers · UK version can’t access bank accounts

slides.wit: The hackers hired an AI intern too.
slides.plain: Microsoft says state-backed groups from China and North Korea use ARTEX, an AI security-testing agent, to break into networks, sometimes within minutes.
slides.sowhat: ARTEX adds no new tricks, only speed. Indian firms must report breaches to CERT-In within 6 hours, and the clock just got tighter.
slides.src: Microsoft Threat Intelligence, 25 Nov; The Register; Help Net Security · CERT-In directions, 2022

stats.l: of tests passed by Claude’s Rust rewrite (April)
of real production inputs it matched at that point

slides.wit: Passed 98% of tests. Matched 24% of reality.
slides.plain: Anthropic used Claude to rewrite its main API from Python to Rust. It passed the tests long before it matched real traffic.
slides.sowhat: After months of fixing, CPU per request fell about 70%. The lesson for any team shipping AI-written code: tests are a rumour until production agrees.
slides.src: Anthropic engineering post “Migrating our Messages API to Rust”, 25 Nov · 70% measured in one region

slides.wit: The cloud went up. The chips went east.
slides.plain: The FCC cleared SpaceX for up to 1M data-centre satellites (25 Nov). Bloomberg found Nvidia’s top Blackwell rack in Shanghai loan filings (27 Nov).
slides.aside: Both need a lot of electricity.
slides.sowhat: Whoever controls the chips controls AI’s speed limit. That’s why India is building its own GPU capacity at C-DAC Pune.
slides.src: FCC order via CNBC, 25 Nov; Bloomberg, 27 Nov · how the chips reached China isn’t established

slides.wit: Sovereign AI now has three jobs.
slides.plain: MeitY launched Chariot‑1 (26 Nov), cleared Sarvam over hosting Chinese open models (25 Nov), and plans ~3,300 GPUs for C-DAC Pune (27 Nov).
slides.aside: Made in India. Debated in India.
slides.sowhat: “Sovereign AI” used to mean our own model. This week it also meant our own chips, and a business that pays the bills.
slides.src: PIB, 26 Nov; Inc42, 25 Nov; NewsBytes, 27 Nov · GPU plan from remarks, no official document yet

slides.k: My take · as an AI PM
slides.t: the week AI had to show its work
slides.sub: every big story was about one question: how do you check an AI?
p: riemann was checked by a computer. claude’s rust code was checked by real traffic. muse checks with you before it pays. this week, the checker was the product.
at work, the first ai demo always looks finished. the real work starts when i ask: how will we know when it’s wrong?
for indian ai founders: build the checker before the feature. a model your customer can verify beats a smarter one they have to trust.

quiz.q: Claude’s Rust rewrite passed 98% of tests. How much real traffic did it match?
